summary: Frontend-only QA on iteration_3 (red/black/white industrial redesign) of CEECO HDPE PIPES SPA at https://ceeco-hdpe.preview.emergentagent.com. All 20 spec categories verified passing on the live preview URL. Color system, typography scale, navbar transparent-to-solid transition, hero, stats, footer, mobile drawer, WhatsApp green retention, and both mock forms (Contact + Careers with role Select) confirmed working. No console errors, no em-dash characters, no legacy navy/blue palette leaking through.

issues: Brand red renders as rgb(198, 16, 40) instead of the spec value rgb(200, 16, 46) / #C8102E. This is because index.css sets --brand-green: 352 85% 42% which converts to rgb(198,16,40). Visually indistinguishable but off by ~2 units per channel. Optional: change HSL to `352 76% 48%` or use hex directly to hit #C8102E exactly.

critical_code_review_comments: Legacy CSS token name `--brand-green` (and Tailwind classes bg-brand-green / text-brand-green / border-brand-green) is retained but now holds the RED value (#C8102E). Functionally correct but semantically confusing — future maintainers may mistake it for green. Consider aliasing to --brand-red / bg-brand-red for clarity in a follow-up cleanup (non-blocking).
Header.jsx correctly toggles transparency via scrollY > 50 on Home, forceSolid on inner pages. Clean implementation with proper cleanup of scroll listener.

Stats.jsx uses IntersectionObserver at threshold 0.3 with a 2500ms count-up (easeOutExpo) — Thousands/Karnataka rendered as static text via a text branch, keeping cells contained. No overflow observed at 1920 or 390 viewports.
WhatsAppButton keeps the inner circle at bg #25D366 (verified rgb(37,211,102)) while everything else moved to red — spec compliant.

Hero.jsx uses ASSETS.factory (FACTORY.jpeg) at opacity-65 with a black gradient overlay; the -bottom-10 PE 80 / PE 100 floating badge sits below the card and does not overlap ISO 9001:2015 · Udyam MSME row.
